excerpts.purpose: Core consensus constants: minCONSENSUS_PCT=67, ledgerMIN_CLOSE 2s, ledgerMIN/MAX_CONSENSUS, ledgerABANDON_CONSENSUS 120s, ledgerIDLE_INTERVAL 15s — close timing and abandon rules for the simulator
Avalanche cutoffs init 50% / mid 65% / late 70% / stuck 95% and avCT_CONSENSUS_PCT=75, avMIN_ROUNDS=2, avSTALLED_ROUNDS=4
getNeededWeight: avalanche state machine advancing required yes-vote % with round time
shouldCloseLedger: all close triggers (majority-closed, idle, MIN_CLOSE, half-prev-round-time) — the ledger-close rule
checkConsensusReached: % math, alone-after-MAX_CONSENSUS rule, stalled shortcut
checkConsensus: No / Yes / MovedOn / Expired verdicts, 3/4-proposer wait, abandon clamp
phaseOpen: open-phase loop and close decision
phaseEstablish: establish-phase loop, transition to accepted
haveConsensus: agree/disagree counting, stalled detection, Expired bow-out logic
updateOurPositions: close-time avalanche (75% declare threshold) and dispute updates
handleWrongLedger: stop proposing, clear state, replay proposals, acquire preferred ledger or enter wrongLedger mode
checkLedger: per-round preferred-vs-local comparison that triggers wrong-ledger recovery
Close-time resolution bins {10,20,30,60,90,120}s, default 30s, increase every 8 / decrease every 1 ledger
getNextLedgerTimeResolution: coarsen on disagreement, refine on agreement — partition time-bin drift rule
ValidationParms: CURRENT_WALL 5m, CURRENT_LOCAL 3m, CURRENT_EARLY 3m, SET_EXPIRES 10m, FRESHNESS 20s
isCurrent: three-window validation currency test
Validations::add: stale rejection, SeqEnforcer, conflicting/multiple/badSeq Byzantine detection, trie update on trusted insert
Validations::expire: 10-minute sweep of validation sets, keep-range handling
Validations::getPreferred: preferred working ledger incl. acquiring-ledger fallback — the fork-choice entry point
Validations::getPreferredLCL: preferred last closed ledger, peer-count fallback
LedgerTrie::getPreferred: branch-support walk, margin rule, tie-break — the fork-resolution algorithm
handleNewValidation: trust marking, add, trusted-current triggers checkAccept, Byzantine logging
Adaptor::validate: build/sign/broadcast our validation incl. amendment votes and hardened-validation fields
onClose flag-ledger gate: amendment/fee voting only when trusted validations for prev ledger >= quorum()
calculateQuorum: 67% formula max(ceil(eff*0.67), ceil(unl*0.6)), publisher-outage disable, 80%-vs-67% comment — the key fork divergence
updateTrusted: per-close trusted-set rebuild, list rotation/expiry, quorum recompute, UNL-blocked lockdown
AmendmentSet computeThreshold + passes: pre-fix 204/256 >= vs post-fix 67/100 strictly-greater majority test
AmendmentTableImpl::doVoting: tfGotMajority / tfLostMajority / enablement logic against the 2-week hold
Amendment thresholds: preFix 204/256, postFix 67/100, defaultAmendmentMajorityTime = 2 weeks
calculateLedgerHash: sha512Half over seq, drops, parentHash, txHash, accountHash, close times, resolution, close flags
checkAccept(hash,seq): trusted-validation count >= quorum() advances mLastValidLedger — the validation gate
Inbound-ledger constants: 5 start peers, +3 per timeout, 3s acquire timeout, 6 retries max, aggressive after 4
InboundLedger::onTimer: timeout handling, peer recruitment, give-up after >6 timeouts (~21s per ledger)
processHeartbeatTimer peer-count gate: below minPeerCount_ forces DISCONNECTED and consensus is not ticked
DisputedTx::stalled: final-avalanche + 2/4-round unchanged + >67%/<33% support test that lets a stalled round accept
ValidatorList::load listThreshold_: config override or publisher majority (size/2+1), truncated for odd counts — the publisher-threshold rule for S-08
